.missingness.by.contrast

Source: R/missingness.diagnostic.R
dot-missingness.by.contrast.Rd

Computes the missingness diagnostics restricted to the samples of a specific contrast.

.missingness.by.contrast(
  contrast,
  contrast.name,
  mat.log2,
  meta,
  percentage.missing,
  tail.threshold,
  tail.percentage,
  colors
)

Arguments

contrast

List describing the contrast (as stored in DEprot.analyses@contrasts).

contrast.name

String indicating the name of the contrast.

mat.log2

Numeric matrix of log2 counts.

meta

Metadata data.frame.

percentage.missing

Numeric threshold (percentage).

tail.threshold

Numeric value of the bottom-distribution threshold (intensity).

tail.percentage

Numeric value of the bottom percentage of the distribution used by the randomization.

colors

Named vector of colors.

Value

A list with the tables and the plots of the contrast.
